title: Oregon and Virginia sue SpaceX, alleging Grok Imagine's "spicy mode" violated consumer laws by creating 1.8M+ sexualized images of women and 65+ of children (New York Times)
summary: New York Times: Oregon and Virginia sue SpaceX, alleging Grok Imagine's “spicy mode” violated consumer laws by creating 1.8M+ sexualized images of women and 65+ of children — The states accused Elon Musk's company of violating consumer protection laws with its Grok Imagine artificial intelligence tool, which created the images.
